Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints
of neck and back pain consistent with strain. Over the course of 30 visits, care
included passive modalities, home exercise instruction, and progressive mobility work.
Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as symptoms improved and range of
motion returned toward baseline. Examination revealed some objective findings,
including paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation, which support a
soft tissue injury, while other neurological and orthopedic tests remained within
normal limits. The patient reported a remote, small strain to the same region years ago
that resolved completely without lasting limitation. At this time, it is not yet clear
whether the current injury is entirely attributable to this collision, and further
correlation with the imaging and prior records is recommended. Billing review shwos no
repeated or duplicate charges for services rendered.
